description: Price over time, from the nightly snapshots Reliquary keeps of every printing it prices (for every printing since November 2026, before that only for owned ones; daily for 90 days, then one a week for a year). WITH a card reference: that printing's unit price per day in `currency` (`price` non-foil, `price_foil` foil, null where it has none), any card, owned or not; `since` is the first day kept (null: no history yet, say so). WITHOUT a card: the user's collection value per day — the cards owned TODAY at each day's prices (a card sold leaves the whole line); `value` sums only the copies that had a price that day and `cards_priced` counts them out of `cards`, so a rise where cards_priced rises is a card whose history starts there, not a price move: say so. Nothing is estimated. include_proxies defaults to FALSE: proxies count as zero, say so when reporting. days: 30 or 90 (a point a day) or 365 (a point a week); default 90. A day reads the latest snapshot at most 14 days old. Prices are Scryfall's list prices (USD from TCGplayer, EUR from Cardmarket); CHF is EUR × the stored ECB rate.

currency.description: Display currency. USD/EUR come from Scryfall; CHF is always EUR × the stored ECB rate. A response that carries `rate_missing` could not price in CHF at all: tell the user that, not that the cards have no price.

name.description: Card name in English or any language Scryfall prints ("Blitzschlag", "Foudre", "稲妻"), used when scryfall_id is absent; an English name is also fuzzy-resolved via Scryfall

scryfall_id.description: Exact Scryfall printing id, if known

name: price_history

cards.description: The collection: copies owned today, each priced at each day's prices

days.description: 30 or 90 (a point a day), 365 (a point a week)

image_uri.description: The card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is; null when the catalogue has none

include_proxies.description: The collection: false leaves proxies out (as zero); say so

price.description: A card: non-foil unit price that day

cards_priced.description: Copies the value covers, out of `cards`: a rise with it is a history starting, not a price move

value.description: The collection: the sum over the copies priced that day; null when none was

rate_missing.description: No rate for the currency: prices are null for want of it, not missing

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

since.description: A card asked: the first day a price was kept; null: no history yet, say so

title: Price history
